criteria.limitations: Database adapter SQL/RLS behavior was intentionally not redesigned; service filtering is the accepted bounded defense.

criteria.description: Authenticated medical-record routes, attachment collection/target paths and reviewed inpatient/laboratory/runtime callbacks forward authoritative account scope while foreign access remains non-disclosing.
criteria.limitations: Only the reviewed first-party callers in this authority are covered; no claim is made for future external or in-process consumers.

criteria.limitations: The full critical suite retains unrelated baseline failures; local verification does not certify remote CI, target, production, disaster recovery, release or distributed operation.

criteria.description: Secret/security scanning, OpenAPI, namespace, migration-source, RLS, deploy-surface, static Helm, deploy checks, lint, formatting and diff hygiene pass for the bounded change.

criteria.description: The child result is reconciled without promoting CVG-003/global ERP readiness, Vetus parity, clinical parity, providers, target operations, production, deployment, release or unrelated modules.
